subject.title: fix(sessions): keep Matrix DM session keys case-distinct per peer

question: Should `session.identityLinks` retain its existing arbitrary canonical-label contract, and if so which compatible provenance representation should distinguish linked labels from native Matrix MXIDs?
rationale: The branch currently resolves the ambiguity by rejecting a formerly accepted persisted configuration shape; choosing a durable compatible encoding or an explicit migration changes the public config and session-upgrade contract.

options.title: Preserve labels and encode provenance
options.body: Retain arbitrary canonical labels, including `@`-prefixed ones, and carry an explicit native-versus-linked discriminator through key construction and alias proof.

options.title: Adopt the restriction with migration
options.body: Keep the new restriction only with an explicit, verified doctor migration and documented upgrade behavior for affected stored configuration and sessions.

recommendation.title: Preserve labels and encode provenance
recommendation.body: Retain arbitrary canonical labels, including `@`-prefixed ones, and carry an explicit native-versus-linked discriminator through key construction and alias proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision extends the Matrix session-key registry and compatibility model introduced by the merged area-defining change.
